normal_hp.value:
As time passes, every player will regenerate lost hitpoints and mana, as long as they have eaten recently (see the page on Regeneration for more information).

Knights regenerate:
* 1 hitpoint every 6 seconds
* 2 mana every 6 seconds

Elite knights regenerate:
* 1 hitpoint every 4 seconds
* 2 mana every 6 seconds


===Promotion===
When a knight reaches level 20, they can purchase a promotion and become an elite knight with certain benefits.
normal_hp.note: Vocation source observation only; exact per-vocation numeric timer needs official or controlled evidence.

normal_mana.note: No official numeric vocation tick table qualified.
